omitted: buildings, workers' mining and production: the core has no economy (each main base is kept as a map feature)
mineral and gas amounts: a field or geyser is only ground that ground units cannot walk
shields, armour and splash as their own rules: the pack reads shields as hp and armour as defence

high ground: SC1 has ranged attackers below it miss 30% of shots; the core gives the higher defender cover instead, and its elevation blocks sight across the plateau where SC1's sight (three squares, Chebyshev) has no line of sight at all
continuous positions: SC1 can start units between squares; each is put on its own square, the nearest free one where two would share
